title: Beta Amyloid PET Imaging for Alzheimer Disease With [18F]-Fluselenamyl
official: Beta Amyloid PET Imaging for Alzheimer Disease: [18F]-Fluselenamyl (Alternative Vehicle) Comparison With [11C]-PIB (FSA-PIB AD)
summary: The purpose of this research study is to determine the safety of a radiotracer 18F-Fluselenamyl using positron emission tomography (PET) imaging.
